title: Moonwater Temple — The Evening Bell
description: A vermilion three-storey pagoda and irimoya worship hall overlook an autumn lotus pond. A gently bowed red bridge connects the approach to the open golden sanctuary; the bell pavilion, branching maples, stone lanterns and raked court retain their original arrangement on compact connected foundations.
